title: 第5章 深夜遭袭现端倪第6章 劫后喜得签到变
slug: 签到玄天我成了万界守护者
content_zh:
雷云散得干净，断崖上只剩焦土味儿和一道歪斜的刀痕。
方浩低头看着掌心，那把菜刀还热着，表面浮现出的细密纹路正缓缓隐去，像被风吹平的沙画。
他刚想把刀收回怀里，手腕一抖，怀中那枚预警罗盘猛地发烫，烫得他差点松手。
“又来？”
他皱眉，“你这破盘子，三天没响，一响就炸？”
话音未落，罗盘“啪”
地裂开，碎片飞溅，其中一片直接嵌进他掌心，血珠顺着指缝往下滴，落地时竟泛出暗红微光。
三具焦尸身上的残符突然自燃，火苗不是橙黄，而是血红，像从骨头里烧出来的。
火焰升腾，扭曲成三道符箓，纸面浮现出扭曲的鬼脸，嘶嘶作响，如活蛇般腾空而起，直扑方浩。
“追魂符？”
他往后一跃，脚跟差点踩空，“谁家办丧事不烧纸，拿我试符？”
符箓速度极快，贴着崖壁滑行，竟无视地形，拐弯如电，眨眼已逼近后心。
他咬牙，甩出菜刀，横身一挡。
刀未落，空中却“噼啪”
一声，凭空炸出一道细小雷弧，正中其中一道血符。
符纸瞬间焦黑，化作灰烬飘散。
“嗯？”
他一愣，“雷还能自己长眼睛？”
剩下两符微微一顿，竟在空中交汇，融合成一张更大的符纸，血光暴涨，符面浮现出一个模糊人脸，嘴唇开合，无声吐出三个字。
他没看清，但黑猫趴在肩上，尾巴炸成鸡毛掸子，低吼：“快跑！

这是血衣尊者的‘血引符’，沾上就脱不了！”
方浩没动。
他盯着那符，忽然咧嘴一笑：“你说它追我？那它知不知道——我这儿还有它买刀的收据？”
符箓猛地一震，仿佛听懂了。
下一瞬，他脚下一滑，借断崖倾斜之势，反身冲向符箓，手中菜刀高举，灵气灌注，怒劈而下！
刀锋未触，空中再次凝聚雷弧，比刚才粗了三倍，呈网状铺开，将整张血符裹住。
“嗤——”
血符剧烈扭曲，发出类似哭嚎的尖鸣，最终炸成血雾，四散飞溅。
雾气落地，竟如活物般蠕动，迅速聚拢，凝成一道人形。
黑袍罩体，面容模糊，周身缠绕着暗红锁链，气息沉如山岳。
“凝气巅峰？”
方浩退了半步，掌心伤口还在渗血，“你这打扮，是刚从哪个殡仪馆跑出来的？”
魔修不语，只抬起手，指尖一勾。
方浩怀中那枚裂开的罗盘碎片突然颤动，竟要自行飞出。
“哟，还带远程回收服务？”
他一把按住胸口，“不退不换，概不保修。”
魔修冷笑：“你这肉身，三个月未沐浴，污垢浸骨，正合我‘血河倒悬阵’所需。
乖乖束手就擒，可免皮肉之苦。”
content_en:
The thunderclouds dispersed completely, leaving only the smell of burnt earth and a skewed knife mark on the cliff.
Fang Hao looked down at his palm. The kitchen knife was still hot, and the fine lines on the surface were slowly disappearing, like a sand painting flattened by the wind.
He was about to take the knife back into his arms, but with a flick of his wrist, the warning compass in his arms suddenly became hot, so hot that he almost let go.
"Again?"
He frowned, "You're a broken plate. It hasn't rung for three days and it explodes as soon as you rung it?"
Before he finished speaking, the compass clicked.
The ground cracked and fragments flew, one of which was directly embedded in his palm. Blood beads dripped down between his fingers, and there was a dark red glow when it hit the ground.
The remaining talismans on the three charred corpses suddenly ignited spontaneously. The flames were not orange, but blood red, as if burning from the bones.
The flames rose and twisted into three talismans. A twisted grimace appeared on the paper, hissing, rising into the air like a living snake, and headed towards Fang Hao.
"Soul Chasing Talisman?"
He jumped back and almost missed the point with his heel, "Who doesn't burn paper during a funeral and test the talisman with me?"
The talisman was extremely fast, gliding along the cliff, ignoring the terrain, turning like lightning, and in the blink of an eye it was approaching the center of the road.
He gritted his teeth, threw out the kitchen knife, and blocked it with his body.
Before the knife fell, there was "crackling" in the air
With a sound, a small lightning arc exploded out of thin air, hitting one of the blood symbols.
The talisman was instantly blackened and turned into ashes.
"Huh?"
He was stunned, "Can Lei still grow eyes on his own?"
The remaining two talismans paused for a moment, then merged in the air and merged into a larger talisman paper. The blood light surged, and a blurry human face appeared on the talisman's surface. The lips opened and closed, and three words were uttered silently.
He didn’t see clearly, but the black cat was lying on his shoulder, its tail exploded into a feather duster, and growled: “Run!
This is the Blood-clothed Venerable's 'Blood Attraction Talisman'. If you get it on, you can't take it off! "
Fang Hao didn't move.
He stared at the talisman and suddenly grinned: "You said it was chasing me? Does it know that I still have the receipt for the knife it bought?"
Fu Lu trembled suddenly, as if he understood.
The next moment, his foot slipped, and he took advantage of the tilt of the cliff to rush towards the talisman. He held the kitchen knife high in his hand, filled it with spiritual energy, and slashed it down angrily!
Before the blade touched it, thunder arcs condensed in the air again, three times thicker than before, spreading out in a net shape, wrapping the entire blood talisman.
"Tsk——"
The blood talisman twisted violently, emitted a scream that resembled a howl, and finally exploded into blood mist, scattering in all directions.
The mist fell to the ground, squirming like a living thing, quickly gathered, and condensed into a human shape.
The body is covered by a black robe, the face is blurred, dark red chains are wrapped around the body, and the aura is as heavy as a mountain.
"Peak Qi Condensation?"
Fang Hao took half a step back, the wound on his palm still oozing blood, "Did you just run out of a funeral home dressed like this?"
The demon cultivator said nothing, just raised his hand and hooked his fingertips.
The cracked compass fragment in Fang Hao's arms suddenly trembled and tried to fly out on its own.
"Hey, you also have a remote recycling service?"
He pressed his chest and said, "No refund, no exchange, no warranty."
The demon cultivator sneered: "Your body, which has not been bathed for three months and is soaked in dirt, is exactly what I need for the 'Blood River Upside Down Formation'.
Be obedient and surrender, so that you can avoid the pain of your skin and flesh. "
